scope: The five leading human contributors to Effect-TS/effect, plus the Effect language-service lead.
Human contributors on the first contributors page for Foldkit and Alchemy, with individual commits backing each biography.
Contributors to packages/xstate-effect at xstate@6.0.0-alpha.73, rather than unrelated XState contributors.
Every currently unprofiled CAFE news author, and the nominees in the who-is-missing thread.
Library and SDK maintainers from the peers list, where public manifests or READMEs establish CAFE work.
Authors explicitly credited for vendored code that itself builds on or teaches the CAFE stack.
decisions: No /news rows were backfilled to admit nominees.
Biographies use names or projects, never assumed gendered pronouns. The content decoder rejects those pronouns before generating assets.
Michael K's example now links the Cloudflare R2 presigned URL signer change, not the GCP AIPlatform change: https://github.com/alchemy-run/alchemy/commit/829d95a6e680ea5ef5dc8205173000b595795eb2.
Vendored eligibility requires the credited code itself to build on or teach the CAFE stack. General-purpose upstream credits remain in PROVENANCE.md, not All Stars.
The work basis records a public project URL, an evidence URL and its checked date.

Rhys Sullivan qualifies through his original Dynamic Software Cloudflare plugin-runtime demo. His effect-qb, confect and kody repositories are forks and are not attributed to him as original projects.
Sandro Maglione qualifies through @typeonce/effect-machine; its manifest names him as author and declares Effect. The unscoped effect-machine package belongs to a different project.
The first five human contributors to Effect exclude automation accounts. The same source lists Sebastian Lorenz and Maxwell Brown alongside Tim Smart, Michael Arnaldi and Giulio Canti.
GitHub organizations remain channels. Nathan Flurry's personal handle is not assigned to the Rivet organization.
Biographies carry their own public evidence URLs and checked dates. Empty repo arrays avoid inventing repository star counts or package claims.
